html.content:
Recommended

ScatterBubble2Dscore: 1.0

Bubble chart — 2D scatter where bubble size encodes a third variable.

Clinical use: Efficacy vs safety vs sample size, three-dimensional biomarker

  • 3 numeric → x, y, size
  • colour bubbles by category

generate_canvasxpress_config with description='bubble chart of <num1> vs <num2> sized by <num3>'

Alternatives

Bubblescore: 1.0

Bubble chart alias — scatter with size-encoded third variable.

Clinical use: Three-dimensional biomarker exploration

  • 3 numeric → x, y, size
  • colour bubbles by category

generate_canvasxpress_config with description='bubble chart of <num1> vs <num2> sized by <num3>'

Scatter2Dscore: 1.0

Points on x/y axes revealing correlation between two numeric variables.

Clinical use: Biomarker vs response, PK/PD, PCA plot by treatment

  • 2+ numeric → x/y scatter
  • colour by category
  • sufficient points

generate_canvasxpress_config with description='scatter plot of <num1> vs <num2> colored by <factor>'

Barscore: 0.95

Vertical or horizontal bars comparing values across categories.

Clinical use: AE counts by SOC/arm, subject counts by group

  • 1+ category + 1+ numeric
  • small-medium dataset
  • manageable category count

generate_canvasxpress_config with description='grouped bar chart of <metric> by <category>'

Boxplotscore: 0.9

Box-and-whisker showing median, IQR, and outliers per group.

Clinical use: Lab value distributions by arm/visit, PK endpoints

  • cat + numeric → distribution by group
  • sufficient n for box stats
  • multiple numeric vars

generate_canvasxpress_config with description='boxplot of <numeric> grouped by <factor>'
